summary.intent: Enhance the summary TUI detail pane to show all available session data (scores, stats, files, tool usage, facets with evidence), fix the repo filter showing nothing, fix the wizard edit intent error, and enable text selection/copy in the TUI.
summary.outcome: Enhanced detail pane implemented with 4 grouped boxes (SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS) showing all previously missing data; repo filter fixed by loading separate repo rows via a new DB query; wizard edit intent wired to a huh form; mouse capture removed so highlight-copy works with pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d for detail scrolling.

repo: The summary TUI loads only the 200 most recent sessions via loadSummarySessions; the repo filter was broken because those 200 sessions were all from feature branches not yet merged to main.

Facets (friction, failure loops, repeated instructions, etc.) are extracted from session transcripts via LLM and backfilled into insightsdb SQLite; sessions start with has_facets=0 and are marked has_facets=1 after extraction.
The wizard WizardIntentEdit case was missing from the switch in memory_loop_cmd.go; the TUI sent the intent but the backend had no handler, producing 'invalid wizard intent: edit'.

tea.WithMouseCellMotion() captures all mouse events for scroll wheel support, which prevents terminal text selection; removing it restores highlight-copy but requires keyboard-only scrolling (pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d).
renderSubSection needed a currentLen int parameter to know whether to prepend a blank separator line before each sub-section.

code.finding: Unhandled keys fall through to the viewport, so pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d scroll the detail pane without interception.
branchRows and repoRows are now separate slices; applyFilter selects the right source based on branchFilter value.
New QueryByCheckpointIDs method added to load sessions filtered to a specific set of checkpoint IDs for the repo filter.
editMemoryLoopWizardRequest function added; pre-populates a huh form with current title/body/keywords and calls EditRecord on submit.
renderCodeBox and renderSignalsBox are new grouped boxes; old renderFrictionBox and renderInsightsBox removed.

workflow: The Codex adversarial review companion script hits ENOBUFS on large repos (git diff too large for internal buffer); background mode also fails for the same reason.
When both branchRows and repoRows need to show the same sample data in tests, pass sampleRowsForTest() as both params to newRootModel.
huh forms can be pre-populated with existing values by assigning them to string variables before passing as pointers to huh.NewText/NewInput.

friction: Codex adversarial review failed with ENOBUFS in both foreground and background modes due to repo size.
replace_all on renderSubSection call sites broke due to format differences — required manual per-site edits.

tea.WithMouseCellMotion() vs text selection is a fundamental conflict; three iterations were needed (remove mouse → scroll breaks → re-add mouse + y copy → user wants highlight copy → remove mouse + keyboard scroll) before landing on the right solution.
The mouse removal commit was interrupted mid-stream by the user changing requirements.
open_items: The 'copy entire detail' y-key feature was added then removed; a proper clipboard copy for the full detail pane could still be useful for sharing session context.
The wizard edit form is a simple huh form but the original spec for edit included richer editing (the editMemoryMsg type was defined but never used); richer edit UI may be needed later.
Memory loop lifecycle.go and memoryloop.go changes (prompt normalization, manual memory scope fix) were committed at end of session but not reviewed in transcript.
implementation_rationale: Grouped 4-box layout (SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS) chosen over flat scroll or tabbed sections because it reduces scrolling while keeping related data co-located — user selected option B in brainstorm.
Repo filter fix uses a separate DB query (QueryByCheckpointIDs) rather than merging with branch rows because they are independent views switched by the '2' key, not a combined dataset.

Mouse capture removed entirely (rather than toggling or using a different mouse mode) because no bubbletea mouse mode allows terminal text selection passthrough — keyboard scroll is the only compatible approach.
huh form used for wizard edit because it matches existing interactive form patterns in the codebase (trail_cmd.go) and requires no new dependencies.
tradeoffs: Removing tea.WithMouseCellMotion() means scroll wheel no longer works in the detail pane; users must use pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d instead — accepted to enable highlight-copy.
renderDetailPlainText was added then removed when the copy-entire-detail feature was dropped; the plain text renderer could be useful if clipboard copy is re-added later.
Separate branchRows/repoRows slices mean double memory usage when both views are loaded, but simplifies filtering and avoids cross-contamination between views.
codebase_patterns: Summary TUI uses bubbletea with a list on the left and a viewport detail pane on the right; j/k navigate the list, unhandled keys fall through to the viewport.
insightsdb queries follow a sessionColumns + scanSessionRow pattern for consistent column selection across query methods.
huh forms in this repo use NewAccessibleForm helper and are run with Run() returning an error; pre-population via pointer to local string variable.
Sub-section rendering in the detail pane uses renderSubSection(s, currentLen, title, lines) where currentLen drives blank-line separation between sections.
Test helpers use sampleRowsForTest() to produce consistent SessionRow fixtures; newRootModelForTest wraps newRootModel with sensible defaults.
